samples.message: Run the notebook with its settings at 15 and 6, and read the two best periods and their ratio from the table of numbers it returns.
Read the box least squares period from the table of your latest run: it is a little under 3.5241 days at every setting the menu allows.

Your box period is 19 of the fit's uncertainties from the fitted one, about 11 with the panel's correlated-noise factor, so the difference survives it. That is not a mistake of the box search: its period is the best point of a grid of boxes, and it was never a number with an error bar of 0.00003.
The separation is about 11 of the larger uncertainties, well beyond three: the difference survives the correction. Enter 1.
